summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.getUTCMonth in its own file, and I found no defects. Step 1 and 2 (RequireInternalSlot) are delegated to date::this_time_value with `?` propagation. Step 3 reads tv. Step 4 returns NaN when tv is NaN. Step 5 returns Number(date::month_from_time(tv)). There are no test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors and no made-up values. The only changes beyond the body are renaming the unused parameters to _args and _new_target and dropping the `let _ = ...` line, which are harmless. Caveat: the helpers date::this_time_value and date::month_from_time live in crate::support::date, which is outside this diff. I could not inspect them. Their behaviour (the slot check in this_time_value and the MonthFromTime arithmetic) rests on the build and the 8 new passing test262 runs with 0 regressions. The step comments are reworded (lowercase dateObj, no underscores) rather than copied verbatim from the stub. This is cosmetic and does not change the steps.
